يتعالج (form VI)
# يَتَعَالَجُ (yataʕālaju) /ja.ta.ʕaː.la.d͡ʒu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَعَالَجَ (taʕālaja)
# يُتَعَالَجُ (yutaʕālaju) /ju.ta.ʕaː.la.d͡ʒu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of تَعَالَجَ (taʕālaja)
# يَتَعَالَجَ (yataʕālaja) /ja.ta.ʕaː.la.d͡ʒa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَعَالَجَ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
